## Project environment classes

`ona_project` now supports `environment_classes`, an ordered list of the environment classes available to the project. List position sets the priority, and each entry selects either a runner environment class or the user's local runner.

```hcl
resource "ona_project" "example" {
  name = "example"

  initializer = {
    specs = [
      { context_url = { url = "https://github.com/example/repo" } },
    ]
  }

  environment_classes = [
    { environment_class_id = "<environment-class-id>" },
    { local_runner = true },
  ]
}
```

- Each entry must set exactly one of `environment_class_id` or `local_runner = true`.
- The API accepts 1 to 30 entries and replaces the entire list on each change. Removing `environment_classes` from configuration leaves the current list in place; the API cannot clear it.
- The `ona_project` data source exposes the list in priority order, including projects without any environment classes.
- If class assignment fails after a project is created, the apply reports an error and preserves the created project in state.

## Dependencies and tooling

- Updated the Gitpod Go SDK to v1.2.0 and refreshed module dependencies and development tools.
- Building the provider from source now requires Go 1.27.1 or newer. Prebuilt provider users do not need Go.
- The integration-test matrix now targets Terraform 1.7 and 1.16. The minimum supported Terraform version remains 1.7.0.
